title: Write MSBuild diagnostics through the anchored workspace destination
outcome: Write MSBuild diagnostics through the anchored workspace destination
acceptance: A focused product regression distinguishes anchored diagnostic I/O from lexical-root I/O without changing parser results or C# evaluation.

During an anchored Linux rebuild, diagnostic writes remain attached to the same anchored workspace directory as indexed reads even if the lexical root is replaced; reserved MSBuild path values retain publication identity.
